title: One Deceiver Is Hiding Here Part 5

series.summary: Rick tests Jerry's memories, but their shared vacation only deepens the suspicion that one parasite is manipulating the house.

cuts.voiceover_text: The room remembers Rick doing something he swears he never did. He returns with a money-making plan, but insists he never pulled it. The contradiction rattles everyone.

Then Jerry's memories are packed with friendship, so Rick tests the one thing that still feels real: a shared vacation. On a boat, Jerry and Sleepy Gary drink, laugh, and kiss. For one moment, their connection feels undeniable.

But the reassurance collapses. People are desperate to escape, and Rick feels a parasite fighting inside his head. The crowd answers with memories of Rick. One deceiver may be turning them against each other, and Rick cannot prove it is not him.
